Subject: Renewal & capacity uptick — MSA edits, exhibits, and sign path for Brightline Health

Hi Claire / Rajiv,

Great talking with Claire last week — thanks again for the time. Per our conversation, I'm following up with the updated order form and a tracked-redline of the MSA so we can align scope and the sign path. High level: Brightline is electing a 20% capacity uplift across inference units for FY27 and wants a 12‑month term with an option to extend. That creates two coordination items from our side: the MSA language for data residency / audit logs and the exhibit that enumerates the uplifted capacity tiers and billing cadence.

I've attached: Brightline_OrderForm_v3.xlsx (new quantities + PRICING tab) and Redline_MSA_sergio_v2.docx (tracked changes focused on Sections 4, 7, 11). We should consolidate comments into a single shared redline before going back to Brightline legal.

Questions for Brightline:
- Your timeline for internal legal/procurement review? (Claire, you mentioned early next week?)
- Any specific audit evidence (SOC2 report snapshot, retention schema) you need inserted as an exhibit?
- Will you provide a PO at signature, or do you require net-45 payment terms to be explicitly stated?

Proposed next steps from Redwood:
1) Internal alignment (legal + sales ops) on the redline today/Tuesday.
2) Send consolidated redline to Brightline legal on Wednesday.
3) Live 30-minute call Thurs to walk through contentious points (data residency / SLA credits).

CCing our legal ops and renewal leads to scope the internal work: Marissa (legal handoff), Karthik (pricing/finance), Naomi (CS — onboarding capacity changes).

Thanks —
Sergio
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
redwoodai.com

Attachments: Brightline_OrderForm_v3.xlsx (spreadsheet), Redline_MSA_sergio_v2.docx (tracked changes, ~12 comments)

Sergio —

Thanks for the follow-up and the files. We are targeting an internal review window next week (legal + procurement) and can be ready for a walkthrough on Thursday 6 Aug at 10:00 AM ET — does that work for your side?

A few quick notes from procurement/legal:
- We need explicit language on data residency for PHI-adjacent telemetry — can you confirm Redwood's default is US-only storage for Brightline data unless we opt into cross-region replication?
- SLA credits: our legal prefers a clearer credit calculation (hours impacted x % credit) for P1 incidents rather than the current descriptive paragraph.
- Payment terms: Brightline standard is net-45. We can discuss flexibility but please flag if Redwood needs net-30 to execute the order.

I'll loop in our procurement lead (Procurement) on PO timing. We'll likely issue a PO on signature within 3 business days.

Happy to join the walkthrough Thursday.

—Claire
VP, Technology Operations
Brightline Health

Subject: RE: Fwd: Renewal & capacity uptick — MSA edits, exhibits, and sign path for Brightline Health

Thanks, Serg. I'm on it — I'll own the consolidated redline and propose concrete wording. Notes from my initial pass:

1) Data residency: add a short Exhibit H (Data Residency & Processing) that states: "Customer data is stored in the United States unless Customer opts into cross-region replication in writing; Redwood will notify Customer 60 days prior to any change in residency." (I will propose exact language in the doc).

2) SLA credits: replace the current paragraph with a table and formula. Draft language to include: "Credit = (Downtime hours in month / Total hours in month) x Monthly recurring charges x Credit factor (50% for P1)." Also adding a cap (e.g., credits not to exceed 100% of monthly recurring charges).

3) Order form / exhibits: the attached exhibit_C_capacity_schedule.csv should be the canonical source of truth. I'll merge pricing changes from Brightline_OrderForm_v3.xlsx into Exhibit C and mark any tier-based discount changes for Karthik to review.

4) Sign path: recommend two-step sign: (1) MSA redline acceptance, (2) order form signature (DocuSign link). This keeps the commercial and legal records separated and speeds procurement.

I will have a consolidated Redline_MSA_consolidated_sergio_mco.docx back to the thread by EOD Tue (4 Aug). Attaching a checklist in the doc for tracking comments.

Marissa
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwoodai.com

Sergio / Marissa —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and for consolidating the redline. The proposed Exhibit H language looks fine to us as written; procurement confirms they will issue a PO on signature (likely same day). Net-45 is acceptable to Brightline. We reviewed the SLA credit formula and that is acceptable — legal only suggested clarifying "Downtime hours" definition (we added a short parenthetical: "Downtime hours = minutes of unavailability during covered hours, rounded to the nearest 15 minutes").

Please send the DocuSign packet (MSA + Order Form) and I'll route to our signatories. Our procurement contact will attach the PO in reply.

Next steps on our side:
- We'll join the Thursday walkthrough if you still want it (we reviewed and are fine; walkthrough optional).
- Expect a PO attached to the signature reply.

Appreciate the fast coordination.

Best,
Claire
